heroSummary: Philadelphia's 180-day calendar opens with kindergarten interview early dismissals from August 25–29. Report card conferences use half-day schedules, and district testing windows cover Keystone exams in January and May plus PSSA testing from April 20 through May 1.
seoTitle: SDP Calendar 2025-2026: Philadelphia Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the SDP 2025-2026 academic calendar with first day, last day, holidays, early dismissal days, Winter Recess, Spring Recess, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The School District of Philadelphia starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on August 25, 2025 and ends on June 11, 2026 with a full day. Winter Recess runs from December 24, 2025 through January 1, 2026, with January 2, 2026 listed as a staff professional development day when school is closed for students. Spring Recess runs from March 30 through April 2, 2026, followed by Good Friday on April 3, 2026. The calendar lists 180 student days, kindergarten interview early dismissals, staff professional development days, report card conference half-days, testing windows, and a graduation window.

calendarFaqs.q: When does SDP start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The School District of Philadelphia starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 25, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SDP Winter Recess in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: SDP Winter Recess runs from Wednesday, December 24, 2025 through Thursday, January 1, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SDP Spring Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: SDP Spring Recess runs from Monday, March 30 through Thursday, April 2, 2026. Good Friday on April 3, 2026 is also a school closure.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the SDP 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The SDP 2025-2026 academic calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for SDP in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Thursday, June 11, 2026, and the calendar marks it as a full day.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the SDP calendar first for the first day of school, kindergarten interview days, early dismissals, report card conferences, staff professional development days, Winter Recess, Spring Recess, testing windows, graduation windows, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare, transportation, work schedules, appointments, and family travel in Philadelphia.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Download Options
customSections.content: Use the SDP calendar tools to view the official PDF source, download a printable PDF, import the ICS calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, save school closure and early dismissal dates, and share school-year dates with family members. Always verify final schedule changes with the official School District of Philadelphia calendar source before making critical plans.
